info.title: Stood platform API
info.summary: Milestone payments held on PayPal (sandbox) and released only on evidence
info.description: Every request carries the platform key (Authorization: Bearer) and a Stood-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v2=<hex HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical request>, within five minutes. Bodies are at most 64 KiB. Stood only talks to the PayPal sandbox.

503.description: Storage or the feature is unavailable; retry with the same idempotency key

tests.description: Only when DONE: every frozen test as it ran on the base commit; a red baseline is all FAIL

evidence_sha256.description: Only when DONE: SHA-256 of the run stored in Stood's evidence bucket

BaselineStatus.description: QUEUED until Stood has run it; INVALID when the frozen tests are not at the base commit as described

CodeTerms.description: Frozen terms of a code milestone (profiles code.*), checked at draft time.

minMutation.description: Mutation-score floor from 0 to 1; no floor (0) when omitted

CodeTermsInput.description: Frozen terms of a code milestone, as a platform sends them.

hold_expires_at.description: Only while HELD: when the hold lapses, Unix milliseconds

approve_url.description: Only while AWAITING_APPROVAL: where the buyer approves

expires_at.description: When the signing request lapses, Unix milliseconds

profile.description: Evidence profile, e.g. code.milestone@1 or code.final@1

params.description: CodeTerms for code.* profiles (checked); other profiles take their own parameters

sentences.description: Plain-language status for the payer and the inspector

UsageAuthority.description: A key Stood is configured to trust, outside the builder's tree

commit.description: The tranche's latest submitted package commit

observedAt.description: When the buyer confirmed use, Unix milliseconds (within 24 hours)

signature.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature over "stood-usage-receipt/v1", allowanceId, trancheId, commit, keyId, root, observedAt and nonce, joined by NUL

UsageReceipt.description: The buyer's signed confirmation that a final milestone is in use

requestSignature.name: Stood-Signature
requestSignature.description: t=<unix seconds>,v2=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, JSON ["stood.request@2", t, method, "/v1"+path+query, Idempotency-Key, If-Match, Content-Type, body])>
